{{Quote|Two days ago the Imperials launched a multiple attack on targets in the Abrion and Dufilvian sectors. They severely damaged the military base at Ord Pardron and captured the Ukio system.|[[Talon Karrde]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
This '''sector defense outpost''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] military installation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Pardron/Legends|Ord Pardron]]. Located under the surface of the planet, the outpost was originally a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] installation for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], before being converted into a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] base used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after Imperial forces abandoned it in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Starfighters from the base&mdash;known as the '''Ord Pardron Starfighter Base'''&mdash;scored numerous victories against Imperial forces during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and the establishment of the New Republic shortly thereafter, the base was retasked to serve as a major [[Sector/Legends|sector]] defense outpost with a full complement of starfighters, [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], and personnel.

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] waged a [[Thrawn campaign|military campaign]] against the New Republic. He ordered [[Task force/Legends|task forces]] of Imperial capital [[Starship/Legends|ships]] to assault several planets within the sector defense outpost's area of responsibility in an effort to draw military assets away from Ord Pardron. With many of its ships and fighters engaged in other systems, the base was [[Battle of Ord Pardron|attacked]] by a task force led by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Death's Head]]''. The base personnel called for reinforcements themselves, which allowed Thrawn to assault his true objective&mdash;the planet [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]]. During the assault, the base was severely damaged.

==Description==
Built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Pardron/Legends|Ord Pardron]], the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] defense outpost was located underground. Originally, it started its operational life as a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] outpost for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] until it was abandoned around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. It was subsequently taken over by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and used as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] base, but was expanded and retasked following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] to be a major [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] defense outpost. The base had no [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]], relying on the presence of heavy metals in the planet's crust to protect it from [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]].<ref name="TLCSB" />

==Occupants==
As a major sector defense outpost, the base was manned by 68,000 personnel, and a full complement of starfighters and [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] were stationed at the base. By [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the outpost had enough resources available to engage Imperial forces in multiple [[Star system/Legends|systems]] across the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion]] and [[Dufilvian sector/Legends|Dufilvian sectors]].<ref name="TLCSB" />

==History==
The Ord Pardron sector defense outpost was formally established by the New Republic following the Battle of Endor, but the base itself had been used by both the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic prior to that. Over the centuries, Ord Pardron was extensively mined by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and Empire for [[Ore/Legends|ores]] and [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] used in the construction of [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Around 1 BBY, the Empire abandoned their base on the planet as they had exhausted most of the mineral resources. The Rebel Alliance took over the Imperial installation shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], establishing the Ord Pardron Starfighter Base.<ref name="TLCSB" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], forces from the Ord Pardron Starfighter Base conducted attacks on Imperial targets, resulting in numerous successes. Imperial forces were unable to find the subterranean base to launch a counter-strike. After the Battle of Endor, the newly formed New Republic retasked the base, expanding it into a major defense outpost. Extra starfighters, capital ships, and personnel were stationed at the base,<ref name="TLCSB" /> which was responsible for protecting New Republic assets in the Abrion and Dufilvian sectors.<ref name="TLC" />

[[File:Ord_Pardron_feints.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Regional map showing Grand Admiral's Thrawn's assaults against Ord Pardron and other planets in the region during his campaign to take Ukio.]]
In 9 ABY, during his [[Thrawn campaign|military campaign]] against the New Republic, Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] intended to capture the planet [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] in the Abrion sector. In order to leave it defenseless for his [[Thrawn's fleet (Galactic Empire)|forces]], Thrawn split his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] into several [[Task force/Legends|task forces]]. Each force was given a target to assault, with the intention of drawing forces away from the outpost at Ord Pardron. The [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Bellicose (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Bellicose'']] led a task force to [[Battle of Ando (Thrawn campaign)|attack]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]], which Ord Pardron responded to by dispatching a force to match them. Similar attacks at other targets, including [[Crondre/Legends|Crondre]] and [[Filve]], were launched, and again Ord Pardron deployed reinforcements to those planets. With most of its military forces away from the planet, the ''Imperial''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Death's Head]]'' and its task force [[Battle of Ord Pardron|hit]] Ord Pardron directly.<ref name="TLC" />

Ord Pardron called for reinforcements from other New Republic bases, which in turn left the planet Ukio&mdash;a major agricultural world in the Abrion sector&mdash;vulnerable. Thrawn managed to [[Battle at Ukio|capture]] Ukio without much effort, while the ''Death's Head'' and her task force caused major damage to the sector defense outpost before withdrawing.<ref name="TLC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ord Pardron sensor defense outpost was first referenced in the third book of [[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy|The Thrawn Trilogy]], ''[[The Last Command]]''. The history of the base was further expanded on in ''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]'' published by [[West End Games]]. In [[2012]], the base was referenced in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''.
